comment: Build config for the Cogitave knowledge platform (docfx.json analog). The format follows the DocFX/Learn learn-pr convention; the engine is ours (namzu/TS build, yuva/Rust serve). Build is decoupled from serve.

build.comment: Content roots. Each entry is a pluggable loader source (monodocs aggregation). dest is the catalog namespace.

content.comment: All learning paths are authored and resolve end to end. Only structural globs are excluded: includes/media/snippets are pulled by reference into units, not loaded as standalone content nodes.

globalMetadata.comment: Lowest-precedence defaults. Precedence: front-matter > fileMetadata > globalMetadata.
globalMetadata.author: cogitave

monikers.comment: Moniker registry shape. ::: moniker range='>=yuva-2.0' ::: resolves against this. Versioning is per-product; a doc is rendered once per applicable moniker.

xref.comment: UID/xref graph. Local UIDs are resolved from the content set; external maps are merged. Identity = immutable dotted UID; the URL may change, the UID does not.

namespaces.comment: Reserved UID namespaces per training type. Identity is decoupled from physical path; paths get a dedicated namespace so the UID graph stays unambiguous. Enforced by the schema gate.

snippets.comment: Central snippet registry for code-by-reference. :::code source=... resolves a file from the registry root; id=... selects a named region delimited by language-native line-comment markers (// <id> … // </id>). range=... selects an inclusive line range. The code-snippet-resolves gate resolves the region; compile-checking is not yet wired into the build (see docs/build-v0.md), so registry files are kept compilable and their symbols are hand-verified against the real package surface. Resolves the snippet-registry open question (central registry, not per-repo loader).

incremental.comment: Incremental build via content-addressed AST hash + dependency graph. Only the transitive closure of changed nodes is rebuilt; no full-site rebuild.

validation.comment: Schema-DSL validates AND interprets. Blocking gate at certificate level: schema + broken xref/link/bookmark are errors, not warnings.

rules.description: Document must validate against its ### YamlMime:<Type> schema.
Required front matter present: title, uid, description (75-300 chars), type, owner, lastReviewed (ISO-8601), products, roles, level.
Every <xref:uid> / @uid resolves in the UID graph.
Every relative link and include path resolves.
Every #anchor resolves to a heading in the target document.

:::code source resolves against the snippet registry (build.snippets.registry, from the content root), id selects a named // <id>…</id> region (or range an inclusive line range). Compile-checking of the resolved region is not yet wired into the build (see docs/build-v0.md).
Knowledge-check questions have >=2 choices and exactly 1 correct in single-answer mode; every choice has an explanation.
Module.badge.uid and LearningPath.trophy.uid exist in achievements.yml.
Every Module.units[] UID resolves to a ModuleUnit; every LearningPath.modules[] UID resolves to a Module.
:::image must carry alt-text; complex images must carry a long description (a11y / cert).
lastReviewed older than the freshness window.

diataxis.comment: The single content taxonomy. type maps to a Diataxis mode.

output.comment: Multiple emit targets from one typed model. HTML for humans; JSON content API + MCP + llms.txt for agents.

jsonContentApi.comment: Catalog + per-UID content API, analogous to the Learn Catalog API.

mcp.comment: Native MCP surface over the build intermediates. Spec 2026-07-28, stateless: no initialize handshake, server/discover is the entry point, protocol version per-request in _meta, resultType on every result. The older 2025-11-25 handshake is not supported.

llmsTxt.comment: llms.txt + llms-full.txt (Jeremy Howard proposal, 2024-09-03). H1 name, blockquote summary, H2 sections of links, Optional section.

search.comment: Edge-first hybrid retrieval in the Rust hot path (Tantivy-class). Static fragmented index for the browser (Pagefind-class) + server BM25 + HNSW vectors + graph-aware re-rank.

publish.comment: region = audience/locale. Publish on a fixed cadence; emit MCP resources/updated + list_changed on change.
